name: Long Video Studio
description: Standalone topic-driven long-form narrated video production by one Long Video Producer. Plans chapters, batches narration, sources economical stills and B-roll, and assembles durable media with video.json progress under assetsRoot/videos/<id> without a series dependency. Install pexels-images, fal-image, fal-cinema, elevenlabs-voice, openai-tts, video-composer and ffmpeg-guide skill templates first, then assign a provider/model to the agent. Configure credentials for the selected narration and visual providers; not every provider is required.
author: AT

variables.description: Pexels API key for stock stills and B-roll when using Pexels.
FAL.ai API key when generating stills or short B-roll clips. Optional when stock or supplied media suffices.
ElevenLabs API key when using ElevenLabs narration. Use configured OpenAI TTS instead if appropriate.
OpenAI API key when using OpenAI narration or Whisper subtitle generation.
